subject.title: feat(plugins): add exact-profile provider usage reads

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `runtime.providerUsage.read` as a permanent public plugin-runtime API after its workspace and alias boundary defects are repaired?
rationale: The patch introduces a new auth-adjacent SDK capability, so the permanent API and compatibility contract require maintainer product and ownership intent beyond the mechanical fixes.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped API
options.body: Approve the API direction after the contributor repairs workspace propagation and alias normalization, with a documented token-free exact-profile contract.

options.title: Keep it internal for now
options.body: Do not expose the new runtime method until an owner defines a broader provider-usage plugin API contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped API
recommendation.body: Approve the API direction after the contributor repairs workspace propagation and alias normalization, with a documented token-free exact-profile contract.
